shortDescription: Anthropic has signed a cloud-computing deal worth $35 billion with Lambda, a cloud provider backed by Nvidia NASDAQ:NVDA, the Wall Street Journal reported on Monday, citing people familiar with the deal.Reuters could not immediately verify the report.
